{{Quote|Imperial Fleet de-cloaked, port side. No, starboard side. They're all around us.|Matto|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Matto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was as a [[Officer/Legends|Security Officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] she was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic Senator and [[Darmas Pollaran]] to ''[[Port Nowhere]]'' alongside [[Kuthana]], [[Presk]], and [[Rowost]] when ''Port Nowhere'' got under attack by the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf's]] fleet before Pollaran was able to drive the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] out.
